title: Post-SQLFix: Property-Guided Repair of LLM-Generated SQL with Runtime Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.41472v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) for Text-to-SQL frequently generate queries with syntax errors, invalid identifier references, or violations of SQL scoping and typing rules. Repairing these errors is a program correctness problem, yet existing approaches rely on Execution Feedback (EF), whose symptom-level, dialect-specific error messages force the LLM to speculate on root causes. We identify an Arbitration Paradox in this paradigm: the system relies on unverified models both to propose repairs and to make the final judgment on whether those repairs satisfy the required properties. We resolve this paradox by reformulating Text-to-SQL repair as property-guided program repair. Our framework, Post-SQLFix, canonicalizes SQL into a dialect-aware Canonical Query Structure (CQS) and validates it through a hierarchical static analyzer with three stratified property layers (Syntactic, Context-Free Structural, Context-Sensitive Semantic). translated_title: Post-SQLFix：基于属性引导与运行时验证的LLM生成SQL修复方法
translated_abstract: 面向Text-to-SQL任务的大型语言模型（LLM）经常生成含有语法错误、无效标识符引用或违反SQL作用域与类型规则的查询。修复这些错误本质上是一个程序正确性问题，然而现有方法依赖于执行反馈（EF），其症状级别且方言相关的错误信息迫使LLM去猜测根本原因。我们在这一范式中识别出一个“仲裁悖论”：系统依赖未经验证的模型既提出修复方案，又对修复方案是否满足所需属性做出最终判断。我们通过将Text-to-SQL修复重新表述为属性引导的程序修复来解决这一悖论。我们的框架Post-SQLFix将SQL规范化为方言感知的规范查询结构（CQS），并通过具有三个分层属性层（语法层、上下文无关结构层、上下文相关语义层）的分层静态分析器对其进行验证。该分析器……
tldr: 该论文提出Post-SQLFix框架，将Text-to-SQL修复重新表述为属性引导的程序修复问题，通过方言感知的规范查询结构（CQS）和三层分层静态分析器对LLM生成的SQL进行验证，从而解决了现有执行反馈方法中“未经验证的模型既提出修复又做最终仲裁”的仲裁悖论。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Post-SQLFix, which reformulates Text-to-SQL repair as property-guided program repair, using a dialect-aware Canonical Query Structure and a hierarchical static analyzer with three stratified property layers to resolve the Arbitration Paradox in execution-feedback-based LLM SQL repair.
